name: Confirm Modal UI
description: UI interaction spec for the generic confirmation dialog.

dom.overlay: .modal-overlay.confirm (display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); z-index:5000)
dom.modal: .modal[role=dialog][aria-modal=true] (min-width:320px; max-width:480px; padding:20px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow))
structure: button.btn-ghost#confirm-cancel (Cancel — padding:6px 14px; background:transparent; border:1px dashed var(--border); cursor:pointer)
button.btn-primary#confirm-ok (dynamic label — padding:6px 14px; destructive has .btn-ok-destructive class)

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Set overlay display:flex, register Escape keydown listener, focus Cancel button, return Promise<boolean>

interactions.name: confirm
interactions.action: done(true) → remove overlay from DOM, remove Escape listener, resolve(true)

interactions.name: cancel_button
interactions.action: done(false) → remove overlay from DOM, remove Escape listener, resolve(false)

security.html_sanitization: Message HTML is sanitized by removing

states.hidden: Overlay in DOM but display:none, no keyboard listener active
states.visible: Overlay display:flex, Escape listener active, Cancel button focused
states.resolved: Overlay removed from DOM entirely, promise resolved

props.destructive: boolean (default: true — applies .btn-ok-destructive style to confirm button)
